• Vendita al dettaglio o cibo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1836, the Swiss family business is today one of the most renowned confiseries in Europe with its exquisite range. The products from Sprüngli stand for the best quality, unique freshness and naturalness. The completed creations bring customers from all over the world to swarm daily.

Demand Planner & Process Automation Specialist (100%)

100%, Zurich

Working at Sprüngli

Do you want to actively shape the future of our supply chain and make a direct contribution to delivery capability with data-based decisions? We look forward to your application. In Paradeplatz we are looking for a committed Demand Planner & Process Automation Specialist (m/f/d) by appointment. In this key role, you will be responsible for operational demand planning, work closely with sales, production and logistics and actively shape the further development of our supply chain and the development of future Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP).

What you do with us

Process development

• Further development of our disposition processes

• Participation in digitalization projects

• Building the future S&OP process

• Participation in SAP S/4HANA optimization projects
Operational needs planning

• Responsibility for short- to medium-term sales and demand planning (0–28 days)

• Maintenance and control of LSF requirements in SAP S/4HANA

• Ongoing optimisation of delivery capability

• Analysis of sales trends and short-term fluctuations in demand
Inventory and flow management

• Monitoring of stocks, transit stocks and closed and quality stocks

• Analysis and correction of shortfalls

• Ensuring high data quality in all sales channels
Cooperation with branches

• Assisting branches with disposition issues

• Support for the centralisation of goods planning

• Training and support of employees regarding new processes
Interface management
Close cooperation with

• Production (PPS)

• Logistics

• Purchase

• IT

• Marketing

• Controlling

What we want

Training

• Higher specialist training or study in business administration, supply chain management, process management or a comparable field of study

• Further training in project management or experience in managing sub-projects of advantage
Professional experience
You have experience in at least one of the following areas:

• Disposition

• Supply Chain Management

• Retail or food
You bring that with you

• Communication strength

• Proactive action

• Self-employed work

• Good process understanding of the supply chain

• Very good SAP knowledge (S/4HANA or SAP R/3) or similar ERP system experience

• Analytical thinking

• High affinity for numbers

• Enjoyment of process optimization

You can look forward to it.

• Individual areas of responsibility as well as development and training opportunities

• Generous allowances and purchase incentives

• Additional free day as a birthday appreciation

• A lively and modern environment with a collegial du culture

• A motivated and committed team that is already looking forward to you

Are you interested?
Then we look forward to your electronic application. *
We are not currently accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this position.
